event_chain.summary: Extortion - data posted by ransom group

summary: The City of Princeton, Texas reported a potential cybersecurity incident on September 18, 2026. Although initial investigation found no evidence of unauthorized access, by October 5 the city confirmed that confidential and personally identifiable information had been exfiltrated from municipal systems. A resident said information from the breach had been posted online by a ransom-demanding group. Forensic investigation of the scope is ongoing.
